title: Sexual Harassment Cases at Workplace and Through Use of Technology
what_it_is: Sexual Harassment Cases at Workplace and Through Use of Technology

sections.label: Sexual harassment and upskirting reports
sections.summary: Sexual harassment and insults of modesty are offences, and Police reports for upskirting and workplace cases averaged about 100 and 20 annually from 2013 to 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Sexual harassment and insults of modesty are offences under the Protection from Harassment Act and section 509 of the Penal Code respectively.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Police do not track how many such cases involved technology specifically.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: However, from 2013 to 2017, an average of about 100 Police reports were filed annually for upskirting, with the use of mobile phones or other image capturing devices.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In the same period, an average of about 20 Police reports were filed annually involving harassment or insults of modesty occurring at the workplace.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Around 97% of these reports were made by females.

sections.label: Reviewing Penal Code outrage of modesty
sections.summary: Outrage of modesty occurs in places including public transport and workplaces, and the Penal Code section is being reviewed holistically.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: Places where outrage of modesty occurs include on public transport, at workplaces and various places.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: We are reviewing the Penal Code and one of these sections that we are looking at is that particular section.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: So, we will review it holistically and see what we need to strengthen.
